# =============================================================================
# vendor/selection.txt — files to vendor from an OAC source checkout.
#
# Each non-comment line is a path RELATIVE TO THE SOURCE `.opencode/` directory.
# scripts/vendor-sync.sh copies them to vendor/oac/.opencode/<path> and records
# them in vendor/oac/bundle.json.
#
# This is the driver-needed subset: the primary agents, the subagents the
# spec-kit-driver delegates to, and the context files the driver references.
#
# NOTE: validated against the OAC source tree at snapshot time (v0.7.1,
# 2026-10-18). Adjust here and re-run vendor-sync if a future source layout
# differs.
# =============================================================================
